lessons.title: What is my business, who is it for and what problem does it solve?
What do I need this business to give me in income, time and flexibility?
How do I set a clear three-year direction for the business?
How do I choose one priority for the next 12 months?
How do I turn that priority into a realistic 90-day plan?

name: Business Planning
purpose: Clarify what your business does, what you need it to provide and which direction and priorities make sense for you.

lessons.title: How do I know if my business idea is worth pursuing?
How do I define my ideal client or customer , specifically, not generally?
How do I research competitors without getting overwhelmed?
How do I design an offer people will pay for?
How do I choose the right business model and route to sale for what I sell?
How do I describe what I sell clearly and explain why someone should choose it?

name: Business Idea and Offer
purpose: Explore whether an idea is worth pursuing, who it is for, what you will sell and why someone might choose it.

lessons.title: How do I choose a business structure and register correctly?
How do I separate business money and organise the records I need?
How do I work out which insurance my business may need?
How do I work out which contracts, terms and agreements my business needs?
What information should I prepare before a contract, terms or policy is drafted or reviewed?
What privacy, data protection and online trading checks apply to my business?
What product, premises, licence or safety checks apply to my business?

name: Business Setup and Protection
purpose: Understand the registrations, records, insurance, agreements and operating checks that may apply, and prepare questions for qualified support.

lessons.title: How do I build a brand that fits my business?
How do I choose values that guide real business decisions?
How do I develop a tone of voice that sounds clear and recognisable?
How do I write about what I do so the right people recognise it is for them?
How do I introduce my business clearly in a conversation?
How do I keep the brand consistent without creating more work?

name: Brand and Messaging
purpose: Develop a clear identity and a consistent way to explain your business in writing, conversation and customer-facing material.

lessons.title: How do I decide what online presence my business actually needs?
What should my website homepage say and include?
How do I set up a professional email address and keep control of my accounts?
How do I choose which social media or directory profiles to use?
How do I check whether my online profiles are doing their job?
How do I make it easy for someone to enquire, book or buy online?

name: Website and Online Presence
purpose: Consider what your business needs online and how people can find it, understand the offer and enquire, book or buy.

lessons.title: How do I choose the right marketing channels instead of trying to be everywhere?
How do I build a simple marketing plan for a small budget?
How do I create useful content without letting it take over?
How do I build and actually use an email list?
How do I stay visible to past clients, customers and warm leads?
How do I ask for referrals in a way that feels natural?
How do I develop a clear professional point of view and build my reputation?
Could talks, podcast interviews or press coverage help my business? How do I approach these opportunities?

name: Marketing and Visibility
purpose: Explore suitable ways to reach people and stay visible, including content, email, referrals and optional speaking or press opportunities.

lessons.title: How do I work out the minimum price I need to charge?
How do I price a service?
How do I price a product and calculate the margin?
How do I choose the right pricing method for what I sell?
How do I quote clearly and decide on deposits, payment plans and discounts?
How do I know when to review or raise my prices?

name: Pricing
purpose: Understand costs and pricing approaches, work through service or product figures and consider how to communicate prices and payment arrangements.

lessons.title: How do I talk about what I do without sounding salesy?
How do I respond to enquiries and decide which ones are a good fit?
How do I run a sales or discovery conversation that helps both sides decide?
How do I write a clear proposal or cost document?
How do I handle objections and price pushback without pressure?
How do I follow up clearly and know when to stop?
How do I build a sales target and know where my next customers will come from?

name: Sales
purpose: Handle enquiries and sales conversations, prepare clear proposals and consider follow-up and sales targets without putting pressure on customers.

lessons.title: How do I onboard a client or customer so they know what to expect?
How do I plan delivery or fulfilment from purchase to completion?
How do I deal with work or requests outside what was agreed?
How do I handle a difficult situation, complaint, return or refund?
How do I ask for useful feedback, reviews and testimonials?
How do I encourage repeat business and appropriate referrals?

name: Client and Customer Experience
purpose: Think through what happens after a purchase, from getting started and delivery to changes, complaints, feedback and repeat business.

lessons.title: How do I make time for the business while working, caring or managing other responsibilities?
How do I get my admin under control and build a weekly routine?
How do I decide which tasks to turn into a repeatable system?
How do I choose tools that will genuinely save time?
How do I use AI safely and know which work still needs a person or specialist?
How do I decide what to delegate and brief someone properly?
How do I protect business data, create backups and prepare for disruption?
How do I manage stock, fulfilment, rotas and busy or quiet periods?

name: Running the Business
purpose: Consider routines, processes, tools and help that make everyday work manageable, including responsible AI use, continuity and busy periods.

lessons.title: How do I work out my startup costs and how much money I need?
How do I separate personal and business finances and set up simple bookkeeping?
How do I build and use a cash-flow forecast?
How do I invoice, record payments and follow up money I am owed?
How do I work out which tax, VAT, filing and record- keeping tasks apply to me?
How do I know when I will break even, make a profit and be able to pay myself?
How do I create a simple 12-month financial plan and use it to make decisions?

name: Business Money
purpose: Understand startup costs, records, cash flow, invoices and the relationship between profit and paying yourself, with preparation for tax questions.

lessons.title: How do I decide whether to grow, stay small, simplify or move from side hustle to full-time?
How do I choose what to grow and set a realistic growth goal?
How do I reduce reliance on one client or income source and test another route?
How do I work out which grants, loans or funding routes may fit my business?
How do I find useful mentors, networks and introductions?
How do I assess a collaboration or partnership before I commit?
How do I decide whether I need an employee, freelancer, associate or outsourced service?
How do I prepare to step back, sell, pivot, pause or close the business?

name: Growth, Funding and Bringing in Help
purpose: Explore whether to grow, stay small or change direction, and consider funding, useful relationships and bringing in help where relevant.
